title: TWO DOWN IN 15 MINUTES, THEN HAALAND AND VAR: NORWAY BEAT DENMARK 3-2!
description:
Denmark led 2-0 inside fifteen minutes. They did not hold on.

Norway came back to win 3-2 and are into the Nations League quarter-finals. Odegaard equalised in the 87th minute. Then, in stoppage time, VAR reviewed a handball by Joachim Andersen, and Erling Haaland scored the penalty.

He tore off his shirt to celebrate and was booked for it. A yellow card for a shirt. Worth it, he might say.

The numbers are silly now: 68 international goals in 61 games, and 25 in the Nations League, which is a record. That is more than a goal a game. The shirt was just keeping up.

A booking for the shirt: fair or harsh? Tell us which side you are on.
